text.p: Bonds closed just slightly below record highs set earlier in the session but traders saw more upside on Wednesday providing Spain remained strong.
"We closed slightly off the highs, but the cash is very well supported and could, along the curve, test new records," said one trader.
The next target on the upside for the futures contract would be 106.50, traders said, providing Spain continued to gain.
One trader said that the market, although driven by the Spanish bonos, was still keeping one eye on the German bunds with the 10-year cash spread slightly below 125 basis points.

Optimism that Spain could be amongst the first wave of countries in monetary union lay behind the advance, with the market convinced that if Spain enters than Portugal will have no problems in joining it.
